newsitem.title: UK: Man sees white sugar prices under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Man sees white sugar prices under pressure.

text.p: The prospect of future exports from central and eastern Europe is likely to keep the white sugar market under pressure, according to international trade house E D & F Man.

In its latest report on "The Sugar Situation," Man said that the outlook for raws "does not look very promising," because of the impending availability of centre/south Brazils and residual sales of Thais hanging in the balance.
"Now, both the Brazilians and the Thais are holding off their sales and it is anyone's guess who is going to give in first and the market will continue to reflect this uncertainty," Man said.

"The tight collar put round both the raws and whites prices is set to remain until the position of the May contract becomes clearer in the case of raws and, in the case of whites, until the position of the east and central European surpluses becomes clearer," the report said.
